IdentityForgeModifier.name: style_modifiers
IdentityForgeModifier.default:
# Prepend a descriptor to ONE element (or a whole group).
# One per line ->  key: descriptor      (delete the # to use a line)
# key = a FIELD (footwear, skin_tone, hair_color, earrings, eye_color, ...)
#    or a GROUP (Body, Face, Hair, Makeup, Jewelry & Nails, Clothing, Setting & Shot)
# Field names are the same labels shown on the Identity Forge node.
#
# THE ONE RULE: the descriptor goes IN FRONT of the value, it does not
# replace it. So keep it to a 1-3 word adjective that reads naturally there.
#   good ->  hair_color: living-flame   (becomes 'living-flame auburn')
#   bad  ->  hair_style: nest of vipers (becomes 'nest of vipers messy bun')
#
# --- materials -------------------------------------------------------
# skin_tone: iridescent
# skin_tone: cracked molten
# skin_tone: carved marble
# skin_tone: moss-and-lichen
# hair_color: living-flame
# eye_color: glowing
#
# --- genres (a whole group at once) ----------------------------------
# Clothing: cyberpunk neon
# Clothing: baroque gilded
# Clothing: post-apocalyptic weathered
# footwear: anti-gravity hover
#
# --- whimsy ----------------------------------------------------------
# Makeup: galaxy-glitter
# earrings: tiny caged
# Setting & Shot: storm-lit
